$comment: How big a server Bemmoly needs, rendered through src/data/capacity.ts on /self-hosting#sizing and /sizing. One entry in sizes[] per server size; a size with no runs is 'Not yet measured' and shows no numbers. Each run is copied as it is from the results file named in source, and tests/capacity.test.ts fails when they differ, so a re-run replaces both together. The people figures are not stored: capacity.ts computes them from a run's requestsPerSecond and the assumption, rounded down.
setup: One server from the one-command install, with Postgres tuned by the installer.

assumption.text: An active person does about one thing every 5 seconds (0.2 requests a second), and about 20% of an organisation is active at the same moment. Both are assumptions, not measurements, and the people figures are rounded down.
